page_title: NIC 1-1 TOU | Nice v Toulouse 25/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+6' Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
90+6' Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
90+6' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) towers above the defence but fails to trouble the keeper, heading the corner kick well wide of the left post from close range.
90+5' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) prepares to take a corner kick.
90+5' Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) unleashes a first-time long-range shot towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper somehow manages to keep it out.

90+4' Badredine Bouanani (Nice) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Guillaume Restes makes a great save.
90+2' Dante (Nice) commits a foul and Bastien Dechepy immediately signals a free kick.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Antoine Mendy limps off the pitch to be replaced by Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice).
89' Antoine Mendy (Nice) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
88' We are about to witness a substitution. Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) is replacing Aron Donnum.
88' Antoine Mendy (Nice) outjumps his marker on the edge of the 6-yard box and heads the resulting corner well wide of the right post.
88' Corner kick. Nice will have an opportunity.
87' Bilal Brahimi (Nice) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
86' Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul.
83' Substitution. Melvin Bard is replaced by Jordan Lotomba (Nice).
83' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Cristian Casseres (Toulouse), who fires in a direct effort inches over the crossbar. What a chance!
82' Bastien Dechepy shows a yellow card to Antoine Mendy (Nice) for his blatant foul.
79' Here is a change. Tanguy Ndombele is going off and Franck Haise gives the last tactical orders to Badredine Bouanani (Nice).
78' Mohamed-Ali Cho goes off the pitch and Bilal Brahimi (Nice) comes on.
78' It's time for a substitution. Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) comes on in place of Vincent Sierro.
76' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Aron Donnum (Toulouse).

73' 1 - 1 Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) meets a perfect cross from Yann Gboho deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the roof of the net. It's 1:1.
71' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marcin Bulka, who smothers the ball.
70' A rebound falls kindly for Vincent Sierro (Toulouse), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
68' The free kick evades the keeper and presents Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) with an almost open goal, but he somehow heads high over the bar from close in.
68' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Bastien Dechepy blows for a foul.
67' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
66' Toulouse are ruled offside.
65' Carles Martinez has decided to substitute Frank Magri and he is replaced by Shavy Babicka (Toulouse).
65' That's the end of the game for Mark McKenzie, who is replaced by Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse).
64' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) wastes a huge chance as he sends a first-time shot from the goal area straight onto the crossbar!
63' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
62' Evann Guessand (Nice) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
61' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
60' Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
56' Dante (Nice) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastien Dechepy had an easy-decision to make.
54' It's a yellow card for Mark McKenzie (Toulouse).
54' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Hicham Boudaoui tees up Jonathan Clauss (Nice) inside the box and he rolls the ball past Guillaume Restes.
53' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
51' Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar.
50' Pablo Rosario (Nice) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
50' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
49' Evann Guessand (Nice) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
48' A player from Toulouse commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
47' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Toulouse.
47' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
46' Referee Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+5' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle and it's Pablo Rosario (Nice) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
45+5' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
45+5' The free kick is delivered by Jonathan Clauss (Nice) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
45+4' Mark McKenzie (Toulouse) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
45+3' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Pablo Rosario (Nice) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
45+1' Melvin Bard (Nice) has tested the patience of referee Bastien Dechepy and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
45' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The Nice players look gutted.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' The Nice players halt their celebrations as referee Bastien Dechepy makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
43' Goal! Evann Guessand finds Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) and he shows great determination to get to the ball and plant a header into the back of the net. 1:0.
41' The free kick from long range, taken by Nice, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
41' A player from Toulouse takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
39' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
38' Melvin Bard (Nice) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Guillaume Restes intercepts the ball.

36' This was a piece of cake for Marcin Bulka. Yann Gboho (Toulouse) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
35' Evann Guessand (Nice) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
33' One of the Toulouse players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
31' The cross into the penalty area from Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
30' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
28' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
27' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) sends a cross into the box, but Marcin Bulka comes off his line to gather the ball.
24' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
23' Frank Magri (Toulouse) picks up a loose pass and unexpectedly unleashes a howitzer from distance, but the effort comes to nothing as a defender gets in the block.
22' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) gets to the ball in the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He didn't hit the ball properly and skies it high over the crossbar.
22' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
20' Nice earn a corner.
20' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) picks up the rebound just a few yards out of the box. He attempts to beat the goalkeeper with a fine shot, but the goalkeeper is on hand to deny him.
19' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jonathan Clauss (Nice).
18' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul after Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) hacks down one of his opponents.
16' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) slams the ball from a long-range free kick. He should have curled it higher to avoid hitting the wall.
15' Foul! Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
12' Frank Magri (Toulouse) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
10' Dante (Nice) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
7' One of the Toulouse players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
6' Mohamed-Ali Cho bends the corner in towards the goal and finds Antoine Mendy (Nice) almost on the goal line, but he somehow contrives to head the ball high over the bar.
6' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) will take the corner.
5' Evann Guessand (Nice) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
4' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
3' A promising first-time strike from inside the box by Tanguy Ndombele (Nice), but his attempt goes just wide of the target.
2' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
1' It looks like Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) saw red with that tackle. Bastien Dechepy won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Toulouse will kick the game off.
Bastien Dechepy is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
